scope: 2007–2010 public-feed catalogue with 476 original topic briefs; first six learning chapters focus on 2008, seventh compares selected evidence across all four years.
method: Four feed pages at start-index 1, 151, 301, 451; deduplicated by Blogger entry ID. Every title and selected passages inspected for an original short topic brief. Relevant passages selected for 21 lessons. Briefs highlight selected themes, not exhaustive full-article analysis. Topic tags are literal keyword matches. Supplementary primers and selected interview commentary are identified separately.
limitations: Not an authenticated original publisher archive.
Deleted, private, unavailable, and unexposed posts cannot be counted.
Feed publication timestamps and dates in titles or URLs can differ.
Some Chinese glyphs and financial abbreviations are corrupted in the source.
Original full article bodies are not included in this study pack.
case_method: Primary corporate reports, regulatory reviews, exchange statistics and contemporaneous original reporting; disclosed facts separated from original teaching interpretation and hypothetical calculations. Some events reused for different lesson concepts.
